# Wowcher

> > Wowcher is a UK-based deals and vouchers platform offering discounted experiences, dining, shopping, and travel across major cities and online retailers.

Wowcher aggregates discount vouchers, experience deals, and seasonal promotions across dining, beauty, wellness, shopping, and travel categories. The platform serves customers across UK cities including London, Birmingham, Manchester, Glasgow, and Newcastle, with curated guides for holidays, Black Friday sales, and gift ideas.

## Key Topics

- Discount vouchers
- London deals
- Restaurant dining
- Spa and wellness
- Travel and breaks
- Activities and entertainment
- Beauty treatments
- Shopping deals
- Afternoon tea
- City breaks
- UK destinations
- Black Friday sales
- Gift cards
- Affiliate program

## Location-Based Deals

- [London Deals](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/deals/london): Browse discounted deals in London across dining, beauty, wellness, and entertainment
- [London Restaurant Deals](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/deals/london/restaurants-food): Discounted restaurant and dining deals in London including afternoon tea and group dining

## Shopping & Discount Codes

- [Online Shop Deals](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/deals/shop): Online shopping deals featuring discounted products across multiple categories
- [UK Discount Codes & Vouchers](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/discountcodes): Discount codes and vouchers from top UK brands across fashion, beauty, and retail

## Guides & Seasonal Deals

- [Black Friday Deals 2025](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/guides/black-friday-deals): Black Friday and winter sale guide featuring tech, spa, travel, and experience deals
- [Holiday Deals Guide](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/guides/holiday-deals): Guide to holiday and travel deals including European destinations and city breaks
- [Wowcher Guides Hub](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/guides/hub): Hub of guides covering gift ideas, spa breaks, and UK destination deals

## Account & Redemption

- [Redeem Gift Card](https://www.wowcher.co.uk/giftcard/redeem): Gift card and wallet redemption page with terms and expiry policy information
